description: Queue a bulk download job for the full list of websites matching a search. Returns a 'hash' ID — use get_download to poll until the CSV file is ready. IMPORTANT: This is an expensive API call that consumes API credits. Only call this if the user has explicitly confirmed they want to start a download. Always use search_code first to preview results and confirm the search is correct before creating a download.

search.description: Boolean search filter. Use 'all' for AND logic, 'any' for OR logic, 'none' to exclude. Each item has a 'type' (code or report) and 'value'. Use get_suggestions first to find report UUIDs for named technologies.

all.description: All of these must match (AND). Typically report UUIDs from get_suggestions.

any.description: At least one of these must match (OR).

none.description: None of these may match (NOT / exclusion).

name: create_download
